name: Infisical Free Tier Secrets Management Reselling
rejection_reason: Infisical Cloud ToS §6.1 grants 'non-transferable, non-sublicensable' license for internal business/personal purposes only. §6.3 explicitly prohibits 'renting, leasing, distributing, sublicensing, or otherwise providing access to the Services to a third party'. Free tier is not a resellable asset; managed secrets wrapper constitutes service bureau/sublicensing violation.
risks: ToS §6.3 explicit prohibition of renting/leasing/distributing/providing access to third party
Account termination risk upon detection of multi-tenant usage
next_steps: REJECTED - do not proceed to TIER1
